commits.message:
feat(resume-builder): wire Performance Insights to real submission history

Depends on the companion jobFynder-BE-nestJS PR's third commit
("add GET /bench/submissions/mine"). Closes out this pass of Tier 2
with no leftover mock data in this screen -- every number shown is
computed from real submissions, or the section is removed/replaced
with an honest empty state when there's no real capability behind it.

What was fabricated before and is now either real or gone:
- "Total Submissions / Shortlisted / Interviews / Placements /
  Marketability Score" summary cards: now 4 real counts computed from
  actual submission statuses (In Screening replaces Shortlisted --
  SCREENING is a real status, "shortlisted" isn't). Marketability
  Score dropped entirely -- there was never a real formula behind it,
  just a hardcoded 56.
- Weekly trend chart: was 3 fabricated percentage series (reply/
  shortlist/interview rate) with no underlying events to compute them
  from. Replaced with a single real series -- actual submission count
  per week, grouped from real submissionDate values. Rewrote
  PerformanceWeeklyTrendChart.tsx to match (single series instead of
  three).
- Per-variant performance cards: dropped "Marketability Score" and
  the reply/shortlist/interview/conversion-rate quad-stat (all
  fabricated percentages), replaced with a real funnel (submitted /
  interview / placed counts) built from submissions whose
  resumeVersionId matches one of the user's real resumes or variants.
  Rewrote PerformanceVariantCard.tsx accordingly. Cards only render
  for resumes that actually have a linked submission; if none do
  (resumeVersionId isn't populated by the current bench-sales
  submission flow yet), shows one honest note instead of 3 empty mock
  cards.
- "AI Recommendations" (3 generic bullet points, no model behind any
  of them) dropped entirely. Replaced with one factually-derived
  check: submissions still in "Submitted" status after 14+ days,
  computed from real dates -- not a comparison to an "average" that
  doesn't exist anywhere in this codebase.
- Recent Application Activity: now the actual most recent submissions
  (job title, client, status, date), not a hardcoded list.
- "Sync Job Tracker" (previously just a success toast, no actual
  sync): replaced with "Refresh", which actually refetches.
- "Track Outcome" button/modal: removed from this screen entirely,
  not just left as a no-op. A consultant has no legitimate way to
  write to Submission.status -- only the recruiter who filed it can
  (checked in submission.service.ts), and status changes carry real
  commission/placement implications. Leaving a "Track Outcome" button
  next to now-real data would imply it writes to the system of
  record when it can't and shouldn't. ConsultantTrackOutcomeModal.tsx
  itself is untouched (not deleted) in case it's reused elsewhere;
  just stopped rendering it from this view.

New: src/services/bench-submissions.ts -- typed client for the new
endpoint.

Verified locally: `tsc --noEmit` clean. Browser pass against the mock
server (extended with a submissions/mine handler returning 3
submissions -- one INTERVIEW, one PLACED both linked to a real created
resume, one 20-day-old SUBMITTED unlinked) -- confirmed all 4 summary
counts, the weekly trend chart, the per-resume funnel card (2
submissions, 1 placed), the stale-submission warning, and the recent
activity list all matched the real input data exactly.
